getJointStates: get all joint positions, velocities, and torques for a pybullet robot body
getMotorJointStates: get joint positions, velocities, and torques for only motor joints of a pybullet robot
setJointPosition: set joint target positions on a pybullet robot using position control with PD gains
multiplyJacobian: multiply a pybullet robot Jacobian matrix by a joint velocity vector to compute end-effector velocity
calculateJacobian: calculate the linear and angular Jacobian matrices for a pybullet robot end-effector link
